loading: Each .hpeq file is a JUCE copyXmlToBinary state block and can be passed directly to FxPluginProcessor::setStateInformation.
designNotes: Vocal dynamic EQ bands are starting points for sibilance and resonance control; tune frequency and threshold to the singer.
Mastering presets deliberately avoid fixed LUFS claims because achieved loudness depends on the input mix.
Mastering chains keep the limiter last, low frequencies centered, and broadband compression subtle.
Backing-vocal presets use stronger filtering and de-essing than lead presets so stacks remain behind the lead.
